accounting: common RDP composition/conversion; analytic Laplace pair integral and exact Gaussian RDP. Fixed cyclic batches use adaptive parallel composition within each epoch, so each record incurs 20 Gaussian releases.
ags_caveat: coordinate releases use analytic shift monotonicity plus interval branch-and-bound over the continuous scale ratio; the separate joint-l1 panel remains numerical. Beta fractions above one exceed the black-box theorem's sufficient beta limit and are justified by the certified direct coordinate RDP accounting.
box_tightening: all sound MILP/LP boxes are intersected with the public clipped-output range and, by nested dataset balls, with every stored enclosing-radius box
clipping_cap_caveat: reported separately from the unconditional MILP/clipping-diameter tail
envelope_smoothness_basis: uses the stated analytic beta-smoothness result for the corrected cross-radius envelope construction; finite-domain tests independently exercise exact envelopes, while relaxed/time-limited solver boxes are not exhaustively neighbor-enumerated
public_postprocessing: Every arm also reports deterministic intercept recalibration on the labeled public validation set. This is postprocessing of each released model and consumes no additional privacy budget; raw results remain alongside it.
selection_caveat: all cells are retained and individually accounted; validation-selected summaries are exploratory because evaluating private-trained candidate releases and selecting among them is not privacy-accounted
